headline: BUNKER HILL + SILVER47 MERGE INTO $326M 'MADE IN AMERICA' SILVER CHAMPION — 38% Premium, Idaho Mine + Alaska/Nevada Pipeline
snippet: Bunker Hill Mining Corp. (TSXV: BNKR) and Silver47 Exploration Corp. (TSXV: AGA) announced August 21, 2026 an all-share merger creating a combined company with a pro forma basic market cap of approximately US$326 million. Silver47 shareholders receive 0.1724 Bunker Hill shares per share — a 38% premium to Silver47's last TSXV close and 30% to its 20-day VWAP. On closing, Bunker Hill shareholders will own approximately 57% and Silver47 approximately 43% of the enlarged company. The deal marries Bunker Hill's anticipated cash flow from the historic Bunker Hill Mine in Idaho's Coeur d'Alene District with Silver47's exploration and development pipeline in Alaska, Nevada, and New Mexico — together representing 80 million measured and 308 million inferred silver-equivalent ounces. Teck Resources provides a US$1M standby draw, with Ocean Partners UK supplying a US$10M concentrate prepayment facility. The combined company intends to rename as Bunker Hill Silver Corp. and list on the main TSX.

headline: GOLIATH RESOURCES SUREBET: 7.38 g/t AuEq OVER 35.7M — Golden Triangle BC Discovery Still Open in All Directions
snippet: Goliath Resources Limited (TSXV: GOT) released August 21, 2026 assay results for drill holes from the Surebet Zone on its 100%-owned Golddigger Property in the Golden Triangle, British Columbia. Best result: hole GD-26-436 returned 7.38 g/t AuEq over 35.7 metres, including 19.51 g/t AuEq over 8.32 metres, within a broader 39.7-metre interval at 6.70 g/t AuEq. Visible gold has now been confirmed in 33 of 52 holes drilled in 2026 — a continuity ratio that is rare at this scale. Goliath has completed 31,994 metres of its planned 98-hole, 2026 program and the Surebet discovery remains open laterally and at depth, with drilling continuing through at least September. At $4,595 spot gold, a high-grade BC discovery with this intercept consistency and open geometry is precisely the type of target commanding institutional attention.

headline: WESTHAVEN PUNCHES BELOW SHOVELNOSE PEA STOPES: 10.04m @ 12.18 g/t Au & 103 g/t Ag — BC Gold Project Mine Plan Set to Grow
snippet: Westhaven Gold Corp. (TSXV: WHN) reported August 20, 2026 the fifth assay batch from its 35,000-metre resource infill program at the South Zone deposit on the Shovelnose Gold Property, southern British Columbia. The headline result — SNR26-117 delivering 10.04 metres at 12.18 g/t gold and 103 g/t silver — is significant because the interval extends mineralization below the deepest mining stopes in Westhaven's 2025 Preliminary Economic Assessment, opening direct upside to the mine plan. A companion hole, SNR26-110, returned 37.34 metres at 6.24 g/t gold and 55 g/t silver in the southeastern portion of the South Zone. Four rigs remain active with the program expected to continue through mid-December 2026, with results feeding an updated MRE and Pre-Feasibility Study targeted for H2 2027.

headline: ELEVRA LITHIUM LOCKS 7-YEAR SPODUMENE DEAL WITH MANGROVE LITHIUM — 144,000 dmt/Year, Price Floor, No Ceiling
snippet: Elevra Lithium Ltd. (ASX: ELV) announced August 21, 2026 a 7-year binding Spodumene Concentrate Supply Agreement with Mangrove Lithium, a North American lithium hydroxide refinery developer. Year 1 contracted volume is 122,000 dry metric tonnes (dmt) on a take-or-pay basis, stepping up to 144,000 dmt per annum from Year 2 with a 7-year renewal option. Pricing is market-linked with a floor above North American Lithium (NAL) production costs and no price ceiling, leaving Elevra fully exposed to spodumene upside while protected from below-cost sales. The agreement is subject to Mangrove achieving Final Investment Decision by December 31, 2028. At a time when most producer offtake carries unfavorable terms, a no-ceiling floor structure with a North American battery-supply-chain customer is a meaningful de-risking of Elevra's revenue base going into the next lithium upcycle.

headline: GDX AT $100 INTRADAY ON RETAIL FLOOD — $419M August Inflows Set Monthly Record; RSI 73 Signals Caution
snippet: The VanEck Gold Miners ETF (GDX) traded as high as $100.33 intraday on Friday August 21, 2026 — testing the century mark for the first time — after a five-session gain of more than 21% that made it the top-performing major U.S. sector ETF of the week. Retail buying imbalances are at their strongest positive readings since February 2026, with August inflows of approximately $419 million tracking toward GDX's best monthly intake in 18 months. The surge leaves the ETF's Relative Strength Index at 73.49 — technically overbought — flagging consolidation risk even as the fundamental case improves: sector-wide AISC margins hit record levels in Q2 at $2,914 per ounce, and aggregate cash treasuries reached $41.3 billion all-time highs. The Jackson Hole speech August 28 is the binary event that will determine whether the retail bid becomes institutional conviction or retreats.

headline: EVOLUTION MINING SIGNALS MORE DEALS AFTER CARNABY BUY — Hasn't Ruled Out Northern Star Assets at Record Gold
snippet: Evolution Mining Ltd. (ASX: EVN) told Bloomberg on August 20, 2026 that it will consider further acquisitions in Australia and North America and has not ruled out buying assets from Northern Star Resources Ltd. should they come to market — comments made shortly after completing its acquisition of Carnaby Resources Ltd. (ASX: CNB) for approximately A$213 million, securing a copper-gold project adjacent to its Ernest Henry mine in Queensland. For junior mining investors, Evolution's stated appetite for more deals at record gold prices signals that mid-tier Australian producers are building asset pipelines rather than solely distributing earnings: a structural bid for development-stage projects with production optionality, especially in copper-gold, remains firmly in place.

headline: SILVER AT $68 IS STILL DOWN 47% FROM JANUARY PEAK AND BARELY OWNED — Contrarian Case Before Jackson Hole
snippet: GoldSilver.com's August 2026 silver outlook challenges the overbought narrative: despite a 14% August rally, silver remains approximately 47% below its January 2026 record high, and speculative positioning sits at roughly the 20th percentile of 60-week crowding — meaning silver is statistically among the least-owned it has been in over a year. The piece argues the market is confusing a strong month with a structurally extended move: silver would need to gain approximately 89% from current levels just to return to its January peak, leaving a large window before positioning-driven ceilings become relevant. For investors in junior silver miners and silver-rich base metal developers, this data suggests the silver bid is less crowded and potentially more durable than the gold equity trade — a meaningful portfolio construction signal entering the Jackson Hole week.

headline: THREE SOFT DATA PRINTS IN ONE WEEK CHANGED EVERYTHING — What the Gold Breakout Actually Tells You About the Rate Path
snippet: GoldSilver.com's August 2026 gold price outlook identifies the clustering of three consecutive U.S. data misses — nonfarm payrolls, the Consumer Price Index, and the Producer Price Index, all in a single week — as the catalytic sequence that compressed September rate-hike odds from 50% to 31% and unlocked gold's push toward $4,500. The analysis argues these prints mattered not just individually but for their simultaneous breakdown of the 'strong economy supports higher rates' narrative across labor, consumer, and producer channels at once. With gold now at $4,595, the piece frames the Aug 28 Jackson Hole speech as a scenario where the bar for new Fed Chair Warsh to overturn this week's repricing is unusually high — absent a sharply hawkish signal, the recalibration is likely to hold.

headline: NEXGOLD GOLDBORO RC INFILL HITS 7.08 g/t Au OVER 5m — 40,000m Nova Scotia Program 76% Complete, PFS on Track
snippet: NexGold Mining Corp. (TSXV: NEXG) reported August 19, 2026 infill RC drill results from the Goldboro Gold Project in Nova Scotia — a past-producing deposit with a combined M&I and Inferred resource of 2.1 million ounces at 2.2 g/t gold. Top results from the 40,000-metre detailed infill program include 5.26 g/t gold over 7.0 metres and 7.08 g/t gold over 5.0 metres. The program was 76% complete at the time of release, designed to confirm grade continuity at high-density spacing ahead of an updated MRE and Pre-Feasibility Study. At $4,500+ gold, a tightly drilled 2.1M oz deposit in a low-risk Canadian jurisdiction with demonstrated grade continuity represents meaningful upside independent of individual drill holes — the PFS derisking programme is the story, and the timeline is credible.

headline: GOLD'S TREASURY RALLY FACES THE RATE TEST — Can Miners' 2:1 Leverage Over Bullion Survive Jackson Hole?
snippet: With gold's Treasury-buyback-driven rally pushing the metal to $4,595 and gold miners amplifying every bullion gain at roughly 2:1 (GDX +21% on gold's +5% for the week), analysts are watching whether the same leverage that powered the upside will cut the other way if Fed Chair Warsh turns hawkish at Jackson Hole on August 28. The contradictory macro setup: the Treasury's long-bond purchases are suppressing yields and supporting gold, while oil above $93/barrel — driven by Iran sanctions pressure — is simultaneously lifting inflation expectations and rate-hike risk. The two forces have been running in parallel this week; whether they remain so through Jackson Hole is the key question for mining equity bulls. Historical data shows miners delivering 2-to-1 upside ratio is consistent with the early innings of structural bull runs — but consolidation risk into a binary speech event is real at RSI 73.
